name: X Panel
author: Andrés Villagrán <andres@villagranquiroz.cl>
description: Opera-GX style persistent X (x.com, Twitter) side panel: one always-on, pinned, floating x.com window toggled from the bar or SUPER+SHIFT+X. Hiding keeps the session alive.

barWidget.description: Toggle the always-on X (x.com) side panel.
